import numpy as np

# Data values (in millions of dollars)
data = [8932, 11600, 16492, 21438, 25511, 26945, 26942, 26182, 26034, 25661]

n = len(data)
print(f"Data points: {n}")
print(f"Data: {data}")

# Calculate mean
mean = np.mean(data)
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

# Calculate variance (using n-1 for sample variance)
variance = np.var(data, ddof=1)
print(f"Variance (sample): {variance}")

# Calculate standard deviation
std_dev = np.std(data, ddof=1)
print(f"Std Dev: {std_dev}")

# Calculate the fourth moment about the mean (m4)
m2 = np.sum((data - mean)**2) / n  # Population variance
m4 = np.sum((data - mean)**4) / n  # Population fourth moment

print(f"\nM2 (population var): {m2}")
print(f"M4 (population 4th moment): {m4}")

# Calculate Fisher excess kurtosis (population)
g2 = (m4 / (m2**2)) - 3
print(f"Fisher excess kurtosis (g2): {g2}")

# Calculate unbiased sample Fisher excess kurtosis
# Formula: G2 = [(n-1)/((n-2)(n-3))] * [(n+1)*g2 + 6]
G2 = ((n-1) / ((n-2)*(n-3))) * ((n+1)*g2 + 6)
print(f"\nUnbiased sample Fisher excess Kurtosis (G2): {G2}")
print(f"Rounded to thousandths: {round(G2, 3)}")
EOF
